trigger_condition.dtype_trigger: Floating-point dtype capable of representing NaN or Inf
trigger_condition.value_trigger: Tensor contains NaN or Inf values
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Differentiable operator torch.topk runs on CUDA tensor containing non-finite values, then backward is called
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: CUDA tensor with requires_grad=True containing NaN or Inf values passed to torch.topk; output is used for backward.

bug_oracle.description: CUDA assert is triggered when backward is performed on topk output derived from non-finite input.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate floating-point tensor values to introduce NaN or Inf, especially for tensors that will require gradients.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct CUDA floating-point tensors with requires_grad=True and place non-finite values in varied positions.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force execution on CUDA with requires_grad=True and non-finite floating-point inputs.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Execute a differentiable operator such as torch.topk on the constructed tensor, then invoke backward; optionally invoke backward more than once to exercise gradient state reuse.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Detect process termination or CUDA assert signals during the backward pass.
